name: indrive.com
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But the TLS certificate expires in 13 days.
lesson: Renew the TLS certificate automatically, and alert well before it expires.
summary: The site's bot protection refused the plain read; the page was analyzed in headless Chrome. Partial analysis: 19 of 19 linked pages answered with a bot check or a block, so the scores rest mostly on the start page. indrive.com scores 64 out of 100 (D). 8 checks fail now, 23 are at risk, and 21 pass. Fix first: the TLS certificate expires in 13 days.

fix.title: The TLS certificate expires in 13 days
fix.fix: Renew now and check that automatic renewal works.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 19 elements on /, for example .p1pholl7.tw\:overflow-visible\!.keen-slider__slide:nth-child(1) > .tw\:w-full[rel="noopener noreferrer"][target="_blank and .p1pholl7.tw\:overflow-visible\!.keen-slider__slide:nth-child(1) >…
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: Certain ARIA roles must be contained by particular parents
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 2 elements on /, for example .tw\:mt-4 > .t1hs3nvn.tw\:w-fit\!.t1nlsggf and .tw\:md\:mb-8 > .t1hs3nvn.tw\:w-fit\!.t1nlsggf. Impact: critical.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 6 elements on /, for example a[data-testid="footer_widget_social_network_0"] and a[data-testid="footer_widget_social_network_1"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: <ul> and <ol> must only directly contain <li>, <script> or <template> elements
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 6 elements on /, for example .n1pqspvl > ul:nth-child(1) and .n1pqspvl > ul:nth-child(2). Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Keep only li, script, or template directly inside ul and ol.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The largest element paints in 1.3 s
Every page has a meta description
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
